text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened when we were invited by the local children's association to put on a traveling hero show.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ? Hey there, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
"...Sis, you're in middle school, right?
Aren't you embarrassed playing superhero?"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around me says it.
"Hero stuff is just for kids."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's not embarrassing at all!
Heroes are passionate and super cool, after all!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
......! But I gave up on watching...
Why would you say something like that...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah! Wait up, you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Could she be...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, preparations are complete!
Have a great time today!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
What is this about...?
Calling me out out of nowhere, and then telling me to watch a show...
choice_data_list: I just want you to watch it with me until the very end.
I just want you to watch it with me until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
Champion of justice and friend to all good kids,
Justice Biko is here!

text_block_list.name: Monster Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Justice Biko!
Today is your doom~!"

text_block_list.name: Monster Dangerous
text_block_list.text:
The wicked adults always get the last laugh♪
Combined Special Move—Amazing Bite!!

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
What?! You little...!!
Waaaahhhhhh?!

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text: Guh, what incredible strength...!

text_block_list.name: Monster Windy
text_block_list.text: Heroes are so lame! Being bad is way cooler!

text_block_list.name: Monster Dangerous
text_block_list.text:
Yearning for justice is so childish.
Once you grow up, everyone discards it out of embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
That's not true!
Heroes only appear before children because there are adults who cherish their own dreams!

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
Loving justice has nothing to do with being an adult or a kid!
What's truly embarrassing is laughing at your own ideals!!

text_block_list.name: Dr. Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're in a pinch, Justice Biko.
In that case, use the secret weapon.

text_block_list.name: Dr. Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is a device that gathers hearts that love justice
and converts them into energy.
Now is the time to power up!

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
In that case—you folks over there!
Lend me a hand!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The boy seems hesitant.
This is where an adult needs to give him a little push.
choice_data_list: Watch me fight as Hero No. 2!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking a deep breath, in a loud voice—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
—...! D-Do your best...
...DO YOUR BEEEEST!!!!

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
My heart of justice... A burning power gathers within!
UOOOOOHHH—...!!

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text: —Ally of justice and good children everywhere, Justice Biko, AWAKEN!! Here goes—Pegasus Mach Strike!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Your cheers reached me loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That courage to be honest with yourself...
Mmm, absolutely amazing!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
...I was always terrified.
Terrified of shouting out loud what I love.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: But I'm fine now. Because in my heart, there's a hero... Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm always on your side, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus... or rather, Justice Biko, shared a firm handshake with the boy before parting ways.

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text: —Kh! You came!
choice_data_list: Ah, the justice-loving Trainer has arrived!
Yeah, the justice-loving Trainer is on the scene!

text_block_list.name: Dr. Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! The energy levels have surged!
It seems Biko-kun and Trainer's justice
are resonating with one another.

text_block_list.name: Justice Biko
text_block_list.text:
Let's combine our strength and crush evil!
Here we go, special move—!!

text_block_list.name: Villainous Monsters
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!
I'VE~~ BEEN~~ DE~~FEAT~~ED~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Did you enjoy the hero show?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"If you're not having fun, don't hold back,
tell Windy-chan! Next time, I'll show you
a real villain's show!"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
No... I want to go to a hero show again.
I...—I love heroes of justice!!
choice_data_list: Looks like you've regained your passion!
Looks like you've regained your passion, huh!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Thanks to all the passionate folks out there.
Thank you, Justice Biko.
And you too, righteous Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: If you ever feel like you're losing your passion again, just call on me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'll come running whenever you need me!
